name: Petroleodd
look: a lumpy pile of glossy black tar with a cream skull over the top of its head, bones stuck in it and two sleepy white eyes peeking out near the bottom
entry: A pile of tar from the bottom of an ancient tar pit, brought back to life with the bones of old Pokémon still inside it. It is sleepy and slow, and anything that touches it comes away stuck.
how: Revive a Bucket of Tar at a Fossil Analyzer (needs CobbleEffort: Kanto). Tar is a sticky black fluid that pools in tar lakes on the surface of badlands, deserts, savannas and swamps, underground, and in tar pits deep underground (around y -30): scoop it up with an empty bucket.
Evolves into Petroleossil at level 45 while holding a King's Rock.
